author: mandalaritra1
body:
#### PR description:

`Herwig7MGMergingSettings_cfi.py` creates `/Herwig/Shower/FxFxHandler` and selects it as the `CascadeHandler` of the LesHouchesHandler, but then sets `MaxPtIsMuF Yes` and `RestrictPhasespace Yes` on `/Herwig/Shower/ShowerHandler`, a different object that this event handler never runs. The `FxFxHandler` therefore keeps the Herwig default and this setting is never applied. The default setting (`MaxPtIsMuF No`) caps the every emission at the softest ME partons mT and prevents high pT jets from developing hard wide-angle radiation. 

This PR moves the two switches to `FxFxHandler` instead which is the intended one.

This is discussed here - https://cms-talk.web.cern.ch/t/possible-issue-observed-with-madgraph-herwig-z-jets-sample-in-run-2-legacy-simulation/147280/9

#### PR validation:

100k identical MG5 MLM LHE events were showered using the current block and also using the corrected configuration to validate the effect. The soft-drop groomed mass distribution of the high pT jet aligns better with Pythia after the fix. Also discussed and confirmed by the generator group here - https://cms-talk.web.cern.ch/t/possible-issue-observed-with-madgraph-herwig-z-jets-sample-in-run-2-legacy-simulation/147280/9 .

title: Herwig7 MG merging: set MaxPtIsMuF/RestrictPhasespace on the active FxFxHandler instead of wrong ShowerHandler
